title: Tensors, Python, and the meaning of a shape
meaning: Squared size of one projected feature as its first input coordinate changes.

title: Linear algebra for representations and projections
meaning: Squared distance along one singular direction, plus irreducible error.

title: Derivatives, Jacobians, and the chain rule
meaning: Loss of the one-neuron model as its weight changes; the bias is held fixed.

title: Probability, conditioning, and statistical estimation
meaning: Average Bernoulli negative log-likelihood for three successes in four trials.

title: Entropy, KL divergence, softmax, and cross-entropy
meaning: Binary cross-entropy with a soft target of 0.7; its derivative is sigmoid minus target.

title: Neural networks, backpropagation, and optimization
meaning: A quadratic training loss whose curvature gives an exact learning-rate stability bound.

title: Language modeling from counts to autoregression
meaning: A row of a learned transition model: its binary next-token loss.

title: Tokenization, byte pairs, and text boundaries
meaning: A deliberately simplified smooth tradeoff between sequence compression and vocabulary cost; real BPE is discrete.

title: Embeddings, distributional learning, and similarity
meaning: Contrastive loss for a query coordinate and three candidates with scores x, -x, and zero.

title: Recurrent networks, sequence-to-sequence, and alignment
meaning: Two recurrent transitions along one scalar path; their derivatives multiply.

title: Attention as differentiable weighted retrieval
meaning: An exact two-slot attention output with values 2 and 10 and relative score x.

title: Queries, keys, values, and scaled dot-product attention
meaning: The log-normalizer of a scaled two-key attention row, exposing its sensitivity.

title: Backpropagating through attention by hand
meaning: A scalar squared loss through a two-slot attention read, requiring both outer and softmax derivatives.

title: Causal masks, padding, packed sequences, and batches
meaning: A supervised binary target after unwanted positions have been excluded; masks are held fixed.

title: Multi-head, multi-query, and grouped-query attention
meaning: One head log-normalizer; separate heads normalize separately before recombination.

title: Position, sinusoidal features, relative biases, and RoPE
meaning: An exact RoPE dot product for unit content vectors as relative position varies continuously for analysis.

title: Residual streams, normalization, and feed-forward blocks
meaning: A scalar residual map with a nonlinear branch; its derivative includes an identity contribution.

title: Encoders, decoders, and cross-attention objectives
meaning: One target-token conditional loss; visibility determines which evidence may set its logit.

title: Build a complete tiny GPT from tensor operations
meaning: A tiny composed language-model logit loss, demonstrating gradients through nonlinear hidden features.

title: Train, validate, checkpoint, and sample a tiny language model
meaning: A training-loss slice used to analyze learning-rate choices independently of the full nonconvex network.

title: Pretraining data, scaling, distributed execution, and memory
meaning: A summed loss with unequal contributions, illustrating why reduction weights matter.

title: Decoding, temperature, KV caches, and serving
meaning: A temperature-scaled binary log-normalizer; temperature changes both probabilities and sensitivity.

title: Exact online attention, sparse patterns, and linear alternatives
meaning: A softmax log-normalizer whose exact value is independent of the tiling order in real arithmetic.

title: Long-context modeling and position extrapolation
meaning: A two-frequency positional score slice; changing the frequency schedule changes its geometry.

title: Evaluation, calibration, and mechanistic investigation
meaning: Expected Brier score when true binary success probability is 0.7.

title: Instruction tuning and supervised response losses
meaning: A single included assistant-token loss; excluded targets contribute no direct objective term.

title: Parameter-efficient tuning, adapters, and LoRA derivatives
meaning: A LoRA factor coordinate loss with the other factor and base held fixed.

title: Quantization, numerical error, and QLoRA
meaning: Smooth reconstruction-error slice around a fixed quantization bin; bin changes are discrete.

title: Mixture-of-experts routing, capacity, and balancing
meaning: A two-expert original-probability weighted top-one branch within a fixed routing region.

title: Knowledge distillation, temperature, and prefix distributions
meaning: Temperature-two binary distillation loss up to a teacher-only constant.

title: Bandits, policies, returns, and Markov decision processes
meaning: Expected bandit reward for a sigmoid policy choosing between arms of means 0.2 and 0.8.

title: Bellman equations, policy evaluation, and dynamic programming
meaning: A squared Bellman-target regression loss with the bootstrap target held fixed.

title: Temporal differences, Q-learning, and exploration
meaning: One tabular action-value regression step toward a fixed sampled TD target.

title: Policy gradients and REINFORCE from the likelihood ratio
meaning: Exact expected bandit return; maximizing this function is the policy-gradient objective.

title: Actor-critic learning and generalized advantage estimation
meaning: A critic regression loss toward the start-state return of a three-step terminal episode.

title: PPO, importance ratios, clipping, and KL monitoring
meaning: The unclipped positive-advantage PPO branch in log-ratio coordinates; outside its region use the piecewise objective.

title: Reward modeling, RLHF, and constrained policy optimization
meaning: Pairwise reward-model negative log-likelihood as the chosen-minus-rejected score gap changes.

title: DPO and the derivation from rewards to policy ratios
meaning: The exact scalar DPO loss for beta 0.4 and reference-adjusted response log-probability gap x.

title: GRPO, group baselines, and verifiable rewards
meaning: An importance-ratio slice before clipping, with old log-probability fixed and a group advantage held constant.

title: Prompting, structured output, search, and test-time computation
meaning: Independent-candidate at-least-one success probability, extended continuously only for sensitivity analysis.

title: Context engineering, persistent memory, and information budgets
meaning: A smooth illustrative utility-versus-context-cost curve; actual item selection is discrete.

title: Dense retrieval, contrastive encoders, and vector search
meaning: One contrastive retrieval row with a positive and two negatives at temperature 0.5.

title: RAG ingestion, BM25, hybrid fusion, and reranking
meaning: BM25 term-frequency saturation with a fixed length-normalization factor of one.

title: Advanced RAG, graph retrieval, and failure diagnosis
meaning: Negative log marginal answer probability when a sigmoid retriever mixes two fixed document-conditioned answers.

title: Tools, bounded agent loops, graphs, and external state
meaning: Illustrative independent retry success probability; real retries can be correlated and side-effectful.

title: LLM judges, ranking, agreement, and controlled experiments
meaning: Pairwise judge-ranking loss for one preferred response; a statistical model of ratings, not proof of truth.

title: Vision transformers, image patches, and CLIP
meaning: One two-candidate image-text contrastive loss at temperature 0.2.

title: Generative vision-language models and cross-modal fusion
meaning: An answer-token loss through a scalar visual connector, showing how supervision reaches the connector.

title: Recurrent depth, recursive transformers, and latent computation
meaning: A two-step shared-weight recurrent loss, with both parameter-use paths differentiated.

title: Recursive improvement, self-training, self-play, and evidence
meaning: Binomial standard-error approximation as independent evaluation sample count changes; x must be positive.

title: Physical AI, partial observability, imitation, and control
meaning: Squared one-step state contraction factor as proportional gain changes in the specified scalar dynamics.

title: Action diffusion, flow matching, and learned world models
meaning: A single noise-prediction coordinate squared loss with a fixed sampled target.

title: Capstone: train, adapt, retrieve, and verify one local system
meaning: A response-format learning loss slice; retrieval and verification remain separate deterministic components.

title: Read papers, reproduce claims, and design the next experiment
meaning: Two-action KL-regularized reward objective; domain is strictly between zero and one.
